item.title: SCGJ Soon To Bring Skill Gap Report On India's BESS Market: Arpit Sharma (CEO)
item.description: One of the mandates of SCGJ was to do skill gap studies, what is the latest update on this? We recently completed a skill gap study on solar energy storage with TERI, which is yet to be launched. We plan to release it by March 2026. We have also completed a skill gap study on bioenergy with support from GIZ, which has been launched but will be published soon. item.title: Video Podcast: What Are They Key Challenges For The Indian BESS Market?
item.description: In the latest video podcast of Saur Energy, Prasanna Singh, Co-Founder of Saur Energy discusses the key issues around the Indian BESS market with Manish Kumar, Deputy Editor with Saur Energy. Singh examines the rapidly evolving Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) market in India, highlighting that storage has shifted from a luxury to a technical necessity for a stable grid. item.title: India Secures $197.67 Mn Rooftop Solar Expansion support from Word Bank's MIGA
item.description: India has secured a $197.67 million guarantee from the guarantee arm of the World Bank Group to advance its rooftop solar expansion plans. The five-year guarantee supports the refinancing of a $500 million World Bank loan extended to the State Bank of India (SBI) for grid-connected solar systems catering to commercial and industrial consumers. item.title: MNRE Amends ALMM Procedure for Wind Turbines, Grants Exemptions for Existing Projects
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has now issued an amendment to the procedure for inclusion and updating of Wind Turbine Models in the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) for wind turbines. The move aims to provide relief to the ongoing wind power projects in light of supply chain constraints in India. item.title: Cleanmax IPO- A Premium For Quality Customers, Investors and Future Prospects

item.title: SECI Issues Tender To Manufacture And Supply 870 MWp Solar Modules in Gujarat
item.description: SECI has issued a tender to manufacture, test, package, supply, and transport 870 MWp of domestically manufactured solar modules with domestically manufactured solar cells for the development of a project in Radhanesda, Banaskantha, Gujarat. SECI is offering 870 MWp as a total package, which is divided into three packages with package capacities of 290 MWp, 580 MWp, and 870 MWp. SECI has sought bids for this project until March 10, 2026.
